info.description:
INDIGO DEPTHS v1.0.0
A mystical indigo-dark theme for web IDEs

INDIGO DEPTHS is a dark, indigo-accented userstyle for web-based code editors and IDE interfaces, designed for use with Stylish/Stylus on sites like VS Code Web, GitHub, CodePen, Replit, StackBlitz, and more. It unifies the editor, sidebar, panels, tabs, and terminal with a deep-space background, soft gray typography, and glowing indigo accents for a focused, low-strain coding experience.​

Syntax highlighting is tuned for readability: indigo keywords and classes, amber strings, cool indigo numbers, violet constants and tags, and subtle comments that fade into the background while staying legible. The theme also customizes gutters, git decorations, find/selection highlights, scrollbars, tooltips, and ANSI terminal colors to maintain a coherent, immersive visual language across the entire workspace.
info.additionalInfo:
Community note

This is an early release of INDIGO DEPTHS and feedback is very welcome. If you notice unreadable elements, unstyled areas on specific IDEs, or have ideas for better contrast or color balance, please share your screenshots, target URLs, and CSS suggestions so the theme can evolve with real-world usage. Contributions, forks, and custom variants (e.g., brighter, higher-contrast, or alt-accent versions) are encouraged for anyone who wants to extend the indigo aesthetic to more tools and workflows.
